conditions.quote_anchor: as soon as that candle closes
we are going to wait for a breakout on the fiveminut chart

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote gives only the 5m breakout wait; the reference to the 15m range high/low is supplied by the condition, not by this anchor.

conditions.quote_anchor: And this alone filters out a ton of false signals.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote asserts false-signal filtering but says nothing about a definitive lower-timeframe breakout being the mechanism.

conditions.quote_anchor: we're going to wait for an overlapping fair value gap that crosses the higher low

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote names an overlapping FVG crossing 'the higher low'; the condition generalizes to range high or low and adds the breakout-candle attribution.

conditions.quote_anchor: That has to be the middle candle. It is even better if the fair value gap overlaps with the actual range high.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote hardens only the middle-candle requirement and calls the range overlap 'even better', while the condition upgrades that optional bonus to a must.

conditions.quote_anchor: we're going to wait for the market to retest that high or low of this initial candle that has a fair value gap overlapping it

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states the retest of the high or low of the initial candle carrying the overlapping FVG almost verbatim.

conditions.quote_anchor: This is where patience pays off because most traders jump in way too early.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote supports the patience framing but contains nothing about the retest confirming the initial displacement.

conditions.quote_anchor: we're only going to take the trade when the retest candle gets engulfed

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote directly conditions taking the trade on the retest candle being engulfed.

conditions.quote_anchor: that engulfing candle, that is your confirmation that this breakout is real and ready to run

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote is a near-verbatim statement that the engulfing candle confirms the breakout is real and ready to run.

conditions.quote_anchor: as soon as that candle closes, that is your entry

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states that the candle's close is the entry, which is exactly the condition.

conditions.quote_anchor: You mark out the high and the low of the first 15minute candle range.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote is the trader's own instruction to mark the high and low of the first 15-minute candle range.

conditions.quote_anchor: displace through that level, and create an overlapping fair value gap

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states displacement through the level plus creation of an overlapping fair value gap, matching the condition.

conditions.quote_anchor: we simply wait for the market to trade back into this gap, retest the high and then give us our engulfing candlestick

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote's retest object is the gap and the high, and the condition drops the trade-back-into-gap element while restating the object as the initial candle.

conditions.quote_anchor: We're going to place our stop loss at this low.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote places the stop at an unspecified 'this low'; the identification with the FVG-forming initial candle is added by the condition.

conditions.quote_anchor: And our first target will be a clean 2.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states the first target is a clean 2, which the condition renders as 2R without altering it.

full_grade_basis.structural_gate: semantic (terminal_read clean); mechanical lints re-stationed to spec-compiler layer

axis3_audit.condition_text: Entry is taken on the close of the confirmation candle.
axis3_audit.support_justification: The truncated quote carries only the close-of-candle timing and never states that entry is taken, nor identifies a confirmation candle.
